Style: stylized 3D casual mobile game collectible card art, animated-movie look, soft rounded chunky shapes, slightly exaggerated proportions, no outlines, stylized material textures with medium detail, soft diffuse warm lighting, glossy highlights, soft contact shadow, the object is the most saturated element, background slightly softer, single object centered, fills about 75% of the width, top 12% of the frame kept clear, toy-like simplified forms with smooth surfaces, thick chunky parts instead of thin lattices or wires, no fine fibers or strands, no small scattered details.
